requirements.description: Host OS, kernel and NVIDIA driver are supported and security-maintained; unsupported Ubuntu 20.04 without verified extended maintenance is a blocker.
K3s/Kubernetes version is currently supported; upgrade, drain and rollback are owner-approved staged operations.
Kubernetes API and management endpoints are private, TLS verified and not publicly exposed.
SSH is key-only, password/root-login disabled and management access restricted.
K3s Kubernetes Secret encryption at rest is enabled and verified; disabled encryption blocks production.
API audit logging is enabled, retained and externally protected against loss/tampering.
SOPS age recipient/key access is least-privilege and a real independently recorded recovery has been exercised.
Backups leave the VM through a declared external provider and meet the agreed RPO; local VM copies do not count as disaster recovery.
A real offsite PostgreSQL backup has been restored and its business data/integrity verified within agreed RTO.
K3s datastore, GitOps configuration and encrypted secrets are recoverable from external evidence and restore has been exercised.
An owner-approved controlled reboot has proved cluster/workload/GPU readiness and persistent data recovery.
Developer RBAC grants only approved namespace operations; direct denied actions were exercised, not inferred from manifests.
Every declared production namespace has all-pod default-deny ingress and egress NetworkPolicies; required exceptions are separately reviewed.
DNS, HTTPS, storage/provider and inference NetworkPolicy exceptions are exercised without permitting unintended traffic.
Every declared production workload container sets CPU and memory requests and limits.
Production namespaces enforce approved Pod Security Admission and containers run with approved least-privilege security contexts.
Flux GitRepository and Kustomization objects exist, are current-generation Ready and not suspended.
Every declared production workload image is pinned to an immutable SHA256 digest.
CI-built image digest has real SBOM, vulnerability scan and verified signature; reviewed Git promotion replaces direct image mutation.
Management/admin access is authenticated, private and rejects unauthorized identities and direct API calls.
OIDC login, logout, expiry, least-privilege roles and unauthorized access failures were exercised.
Production branch protection requires passing checks and owner-approved PR promotion; CI holds no production kubeconfig.
If Atlantis is deployed, plans/apply require repository and owner approvals; otherwise externally verify that Atlantis is not deployed.
Real workload/storage/GPU/auth failure alerts reach the declared external recipient and delivery evidence exists.
Actual licensed model weights execute on the NVIDIA GPU, readiness proves loaded weights/GPU, and missing model/provider produces finite unavailable failure rather than fake output.
Single-node architecture is explicitly acknowledged without HA claims, with owner-approved RPO/RTO and recovery responsibilities.
Dashboard KPI values reconcile with real authoritative queries in an exercised scenario.
Missing CSAT is represented as missing, never as zero.
A viewer cannot write through direct analytics API requests.
AI dashboard numeric claims are grounded in authoritative supplied metrics.
Dashboard refresh failure retains the last good result.
Unsupported virtual try-on input is rejected.
Duplicate virtual try-on operation creates exactly one job.
Output whose selected variant does not match the requested variant is rejected.
Virtual try-on timeout reaches a finite terminal state.
Cancelled or failed virtual try-on jobs never report fake success.
Enhanced catalog images cannot publish without approval.
An unchanged old image does not create a new enhancement job.
Enhancement failure preserves the original image.
Only validated selected catalog images enter enhancement.
Visual search rejects images larger than 5 MB before AI processing.
Non-clothing images do not receive clothing matching results.
Visual search returns at most 20 matches, each with similarity at least 0.45.
Visual-search refinement does not re-upload the original image.
Visual-search privacy policy avoids long image retention and its deletion behavior is exercised.
Loyalty points accrue only for delivered orders.
Duplicate delivery events do not accrue points twice.
Point redemption is capped at 50 percent of the post-voucher eligible amount.
The referrer receives no registration-only reward.
Referral reward processing cannot award a duplicate reward.
A full return reverses the corresponding referral reward.
Personal-color analysis failure preserves the saved color profile.
Unsupported personal-color taxonomy values are rejected.
Low-confidence color inference performs no profile write.
Only an explicitly confirmed color analysis is saved.
The recommender does not use unconfirmed personal-color analysis.
A guest without verified OTP cannot access private order information.
Human takeover stops AI messages for the conversation.
Chatbot cannot promise unauthorized refunds or discounts.
Human handoff is idempotent and targets the correct conversation/session.
A failed chatbot risk check rejects the message instead of sending it.
SEO generation does not invent product material or unsupported catalog facts.
Generated SEO draft content is not publicly published.
SEO regeneration preserves the currently published content.
SEO draft references the correct product ID and catalog revision.
